title: V2-5 backlog: bincode snapshot + accrue_marks doc
brief: Two nits from Sprint V2-5 review that do not block functionality but should be addressed.

items.description: snap_keep_imp_replay_guard is marked #[ignore] in pwm-core/src/state.rs because the new serde deserialize_with on Account.marks is incompatible with bincode serialization (used in some internal snapshot paths). Fix: either replace bincode round-trip in that test with JSON, or add a bincode-compatible migration shim. Until fixed, bincode-based snapshot paths may not correctly migrate legacy marks values.
The doc comment on accrue_marks() and accrue_marks_v2() in state.rs still describes the old formula. Update to reflect: matured = (staked / PWM_RAW_SCALE) * hours.
